cto_solo_authority.rationale: As the authenticated CTO and sole human review authority, Patrick Hamid authorizes the Vantage 2.1.0 candidate to use the controller's narrowly defined solo-authority route for the verified, content-frozen evidence checkpoint. This authority changes who supplies the human gate decisions; it does not waive tests, migration integrity, tenant isolation, secret delivery, runtime identity, rollback, health, readiness, live verification, or publication controls. 78/78 Node tests pass, the Vite production build succeeds, all 5 repository-owned invariant checks pass, and the pre-freeze contract matrix (schema 1.2, including a live TrueNAS dependency probe with a negative control and a bounded-resource check) validates PASS.
cto_solo_authority.residual_risk: Human-gate separation is reduced because one authenticated CTO supplies the approved decisions after all configured independent review sources were attempted. The release remains blocked if any mandatory technical, migration, security, recovery, or live-verification control fails. The pre-existing visual-style contract gap is carried separately as a time-bound, CTO-approved deviation, not waived by this authorization.

validation.pre_deploy_summary: Signed candidate d50cbe01066d3a8332bf8ec518213cb3f3023753 (PR #14/#15 web-flow merges over Vantage 2.0.0 c8f0549) adds tenant-scoped, human-readable service-reference labels ('connect your own services'): a shared server/service-reference.js validator/normalizer rejects any credential-shaped value (tokens, URLs, secrets) on both the API write path and legacy-data startup cleanup; admin-only mutation with member-visible read access; and legacy 'integration'/'integration_sync' rows are redacted on migration. 78/78 Node tests pass (including new segmented-credential-rejection and legacy integration_sync migration-redaction regression tests), the Vite production build succeeds, and all 5 repository-owned invariant checks in scripts/verify-invariants.mjs pass. Independent code review returned APPROVE and independent QA returned PASS on this exact commit.

The production session secret remains file-backed and read-only at /run/secrets/vantage-session-secret; no secret value was recorded.

exceptions.compensating_control: Complete and validate the estate visual token/theme migration for every Vantage UI surface before this exception expires. This deviation does not waive tests, migration integrity, tenant isolation, secret delivery, runtime identity, rollback, health, readiness, live verification, or publication controls.
exceptions.residual_risk: The Vantage UI remains visually inconsistent with the estate-wide theme, token, typography, radius, and colour-literal contract until remediated. This deviation accepts no security, identity, authorization, migration, availability, accessibility, or tenant-data-isolation risk.
